body.t: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.

hint.t: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.

body.t: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.

prompt.t: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?

why.t: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.

prompt.t: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?

body.t: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
